description_en: Retrieves the DTS IP addresses that must be added to the whitelists of both the source and destination databases
description_zh: 获取源库和目标库的白名单都需要添加的DTS IP地址
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-dts-ip --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --source-endpoint-region cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDTSIP

parameters.help_en: The region in which the DTS task instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS任务实例所在地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the source instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html.
If the source instance is a self-managed database that has a public IP address, you can specify ap-southeast-1 or the region ID that is geographically closest to the self-managed database
parameters.help_zh:
源实例所属地域ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html。
如果源实例为有公网IP的自建数据库，则可以传入cn-hangzhou或者离自建数据库物理距离最近的区域ID
parameters.name: source_endpoint_region

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the destination instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html.
If the destination instance is a self-managed database that has a public IP address, you can specify ap-southeast-1 or the region ID that is geographically closest to the self-managed database
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例所属地域ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html。
如果目标实例为有公网IP的自建数据库，则可以传入cn-hangzhou或者离自建数据库物理距离最近的区域ID
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_region
